label: Street market topic context
explanation: The feature fires on many tokens—mostly common function words and punctuation—when the surrounding passage is about markets, street vendors, food stalls, antique fairs, or urban shopping districts, as in the Eastern Market descriptions; it is not triggered by any specific word or position. It fires most strongly in dense, vivid descriptions of such places and their people, and stays silent or fires only weakly in unrelated topics like personal anecdotes, beach scenes, or technical text.
